releaseNotes:
• New: Requests. Can't find a movie or TV show? Search for it and request it, and you'll be told when it's added.
• New: Report a problem with a movie or episode, or report missing episodes from a show's page. You can delete a report from the Requests page if you made it by mistake.
• Going back to Movies or TV Shows now returns you to the title you were on.
• A cleaner look: compact icon buttons and simpler home screen cards.
